verdict.rationale: Reflect documents semantic/full-text search plus filtering by date, daily notes, backlinks, tags, and pinned status, but there's no evidence of filtering by 'properties' or note paths (Reflect doesn't appear to have a properties/path system like folder-based tools), and offline capability is only described for capturing notes, not for offline search. missing for 10: property filters, path filters, explicit confirmation that search works offline.
